# MBTA Tracker

> MBTA Tracker is a search-first, realtime MBTA transit information tool for Boston riders. It presents arrivals, routes, stops, vehicles, and visible connection/freshness state. It does not replace official MBTA service alerts.

## Canonical source

- https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/

## Essential public pages

- Live tracker: https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/
- Share page: https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/share
- Delay guide: https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/guides/how-to-check-mbta-delays
- Commute-planning guide: https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/guides/mbta-commute-planner
- Red Line: https://mbta.ai-aarti.com/mbta/routes/red-line
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/aartisr/mbta-tracker

## Responsible use

- Treat arrival and vehicle data as realtime information that can be delayed or incomplete.
- Direct riders to official MBTA communications for major disruptions and agency-authoritative alerts.
- Do not claim that heuristic crowding forecasts are measured occupancy data.
